fact: LISGIS's Socioeconomic Statistical Bulletin Vol. 4 No. 1 (December 2023), its first since 2011, publishes social, demographic and economic statistics compiled from administrative data of ministries, agencies and commissions (including Agriculture, Education, Health, Transport, Police), built with HISWA project funding and an Administrative Data Technical Committee.
title: Socioeconomic Statistical Bulletin, Vol. 4 No. 01
publisher: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services (LISGIS)
why_not: already-held: the December 2023 bulletin is held as LBR-001
